原文来自ICN —— 拟石莲属属下E. subcorymbosa 词条
翻译：种花小医杂家赵一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。
Series Racemosae.
总状花序系Distribution : Mexico (Oaxaca :North of Santiago Juxtlahuaca)
分布：墨西哥（瓦哈卡州：Santiago Juxtlahuaca以北）Description (according to IHSP 2003) :
描述（根据2003年的IHSP）：Stem usually < 4 cm long, 5 – 8 mm in diameter.
茎通常短于4厘米，直径5 - 8毫米。Rosette 4 – 6 cm in diameter.
莲座直径约4到6厘米Leaves obovate-spatulate, cuspidate, 1,5 – 3 x 0,8 – 2,5 cm wide at the widest part, glaucous bluish-grey, often red-flecked beneath, margins reddish.
叶：倒卵状匙形，尖，1.5 - 3厘米长，0.8 - 2.5厘米宽(在较宽的部分)，叶为带有白霜的蓝灰色，叶背面常有红色斑点，叶缘红色。Inflorescences:4,5 – 11 cm, racemose but appearing corymbose because of the long lower pedicels, pedicels sub-erect, 1 – 3 cm, the lowest the longest, each with 1 – 3 minute bracts.
花序：4,5 - 11厘米，总状花序，因为下方的花梗较长，故形似伞房花序。花梗直立，1 - 3厘米长。低位的花梗较长，每个花梗有1 - 3个小苞片。Flowers 3 – 12, sepals slightly ascending, 5 – 11 x 2 – 3 mm, corolla ovoid, pentagonal, 8 – 14 x 6 – 8 mm in diameter, 3 – 4 mm in diameter at the mouth, petals oblong, subobtuse, lower portion reddish-orange, upper part yellow.
花：3 - 12（朵）。萼片稍微上翘，5 - 11毫米长，2 - 3毫米宽。花冠卵圆形，五角形。8 - 14毫米长，花管6 - 8毫米直径，花朵开口3 -4毫米宽。花瓣长圆形，稍钝，近花梗处红橙色，上部黄色。Cytology : n = 29
细胞学检查：染色体数29The population from Tlacotepec has much wider leaves and may be deserving of varietal status.
在Tlacotepec分布的subcorymbosa种群有更宽大的叶片，可能足以获得独立物种地位。
E. subcorymbosa Lau 030 in habitat near Laguna Encantada, Oaxaca, Mexico.
